description: This file declares the interface for the factory class IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory, which provides methods to create instances of server manager module services within the Rialto IPC framework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external dependencies.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create instances of server manager module services.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ServerManagerModule object, given a session server manager, returning a shared pointer to the object.
